sentences.text:
Biswajit Das vs Unknown on 15 March, 2024
15.03.2024.
24.

In Re:- An application for bail under Section 439 of the Code  of Criminal Procedure in connection Balagarh P.S. Case No.08  of 2019 dated 11.01.2019 under Sections 498A/302 of the  Indian Penal Code and charge sheet submitted under Sections  498A/302 of the Indian Penal Code.
 In the matter of : Biswajit Das.
 ... Petitioner.
 Mr. Jyoti Prakash Chatterjee.
 ...for the Petitioner.
 Mr. Navanil De.
 ...for the State.
 1.
Heard the learned Advocates for the parties.
2. Perused report submitted by the Registrar (Judicial Services).
Process to fill up the vacancies in the Fast Track Courts including the trial court is in progress and the vacancies shall be filled up shortly.
3. We have considered the materials on record.
Bail prayer of the petitioner was rejected earlier.
Allegations are grave and the case is at its fag end.
4. Under such circumstances and as it is expected that the vacancy shall be filled up shortly, we are not inclined to grant bail to the petitioner at this stage.
5. Accordingly, the prayer for bail of the petitioner is rejected.

(Ajay Kumar Gupta, J.) (Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
